Body.Content:
Start every collections day with one prioritized view of your receivables portfolio that explains each recommendation. The skill shows which customers need attention, why, and what to do next. It helps collectors, collection managers and accounts receivable (AR) leaders act consistently, close periods with fewer surprises, and step in before overdue balances become bad debt.

GA date: February CY2027

Preview date: December CY2026
